behavior_contracts.A2.4/normalization: Public fetch/judge infrastructure failures normalize at native origins only: a native leaf occurrence produced for the calling operation maps to a fresh http::request_failed (1106) occurrence whose Detail payload is the original typed leaf and whose private cause is the original occurrence. Classification keys on the LF09 (boundary, operation) provenance pair plus leaf identity, never the error name alone. Producers tag native truthfully; only the two normalization boundaries (named fetch, TypeSafe judge) map.
behavior_contracts.A2.4/detail: http::failure_detail is a non-constructible variant over exactly the seven pre-existing typed leaves (1100 invalid_request, 1101 credentials_missing, 1102 transport_failed, 1103 timeout, 1104 body_limit, 1105 status_error, 1110 codec invalid_data). 1106 request_failed carries one field: detail http::failure_detail. Selective recovery matches failed.detail against the unchanged leaf shapes.
